svg.desc: Isometric partitions and hex clusters: care. A wall of identical cubes stacked two high runs along the two back edges and shelters three single cubes with lit tops, open toward us. After B015 Isometric Allotment (partition, hashed heights, painter's order), B018 Hex Terraces (roots reserve neighbours), B068 Soft Brutalism (flat three-tone light), B098 Terraced Reaction. Structure: one module, identical cubes on one grid with one gap. Process: whole cubes stacked, painted back to front by x+y+z on a (7,4) (-7,4) (0,-8) lattice. Mark: paper on the subject's top, the value's colour on every lit face, ground through the shade face, 3-unit ink where faces meet. Params {C:4,G:2,n:4,wall:2,inside:[[1,1],[2,1],[1,2]]}. Seed rng("GEW06-care-m").
